faq.q: How many cards are in a tarot deck?
faq.a: A standard deck has 78 cards, with 22 Major Arcana and 56 Minor Arcana.

faq.q: Can I teach myself to read tarot?
faq.a: Yes. Draw one card, notice a detail and compare it with the card’s meaning.

faq.q: What do the four card suits symbolize?
faq.a: Here, Wands suggest action, Cups feelings, Swords thought, Pentacles resources.
Each of the four suits has a Page, Knight, Queen and King.

faq.q: Is there a correct way to shuffle tarot?
faq.a: No. Move small packets if the deck is hard to hold.

faq.q: Can I pull tarot cards online?
faq.a: Yes. Open the random draw and turn over a card.

faq.q: How to do a daily tarot card reading?
faq.a: Draw one card, note a detail and see what reminds you of it later that day.

faq.q: What not to ask in a tarot reading?
faq.a: Avoid asking for a diagnosis or certainty about someone else’s thoughts.

faq.q: Do you have to read tarot cards in reverse?
faq.a: No. Decide before drawing. With reversals, consider where the theme feels stuck.

faq.q: Can tarot tell you how someone feels about you?
faq.a: Cards can’t confirm someone’s feelings. Decide what you want to ask them.

faq.q: How do I know if a tarot card is a yes or no?
faq.a: There’s no universal list. Ask what would make the answer yes or no.

faq.q: Can tarot cards predict the future?
faq.a: Cards can’t tell what will happen. Use them to explore what you could do.

libraryFact: Look up {cards} cards, upright or reversed, in {languages} languages. The website is free. Enter the cards from your physical deck without creating an account.
webBoundary: The website offers reference text and practice prompts. It does not send your question or cards to an AI service or spend app credits.
savedNote: Your saved reflection stays in this browser on this device. Saving again replaces it. Export a copy before clearing browser data or switching devices.
draftExport: Export text downloads the current draft. In the three-card example, the file includes all three positions and each card’s orientation. Export your draft before restoring a saved reflection if you want to keep both.
